data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating Mapbox Maps on Android, iOS, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Integrates interactive and customizable vector maps inside a Flutter widget using Mapbox GL Native on mobile and Mapbox GL JS on web. Supports styles, cameras, gestures, various layers (symbol, circle, line, fill, raster), and offline regional downloading.
use_when: You need Mapbox maps inside your Android, iOS, or web Flutter application.
You require custom vector map styles, layers, and symbol annotations.
You need offline map tile downloading and sideloading capabilities.
avoid_when: You require official Mapbox supported products (this is community-driven).
You want to use Google Maps instead.
You need a fully declarative mapping solution without imperative controllers.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Provides a wide range of layer types (Raster, Symbol, Circle, Line, Fill, Hillshade).
Includes support for offline region downloading and sideloading.
weaknesses: Community-driven and not an official Mapbox product.
Requires manual setup of secret access tokens with Downloads: Read scope for mobile builds.
Does not support all native Mapbox API features (e.g., style DSL, heatmap layers).
data.setup_notes: Requires a secret Mapbox access token with Downloads: Read scope for Android/iOS builds, a public token passed via --dart-define, configuration of index.html for Web, and specific permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist for location features.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Google Maps instead of Mapbox for your application.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a pure Dart interactive map solution using OpenStreetMap tiles without native SDK setup complexities.
